audit_title: Theme / Motif Identity Evidence Readiness Audit for PF-001 Physical Classical Corpus
governing_principle: Do not promote synthetic segment identity into thematic identity. Theme/motif identity requires accepted, lineage-valid human annotations or explicit recurrence-family metadata.

lineage_policy_verdict.rationale: The canonical theme manifest (data/annotations/theme_v1/manifest.yaml) contains 0 accepted annotations across the 62 verified physical scores. The RC-008B pilot candidate set contains 20 algorithmic/AI-reviewed proposals with human_accepted_count = 0. Assigning theme identity to arbitrary sampled musical windows without independently documented human or musicological thematic adjudication violates the Perception-First Measurement Contract. Therefore, THEME_MOTIF_IDENTITY remains non-operational for calibration until formal human adjudication is executed.
